purpose: Create exact-replayable synthetic RGB/Z-depth supervision directly from the licensed MHR TorchScript and its actual topology, then prove the generator's geometry is internally reversible before any formal training uses it.
scope_exclusions: no medical labels or DMD37 claims
no claim that bounded random MHR parameters are a natural-pose distribution

implementation.runtime: the existing CUDA environment that loads the official SAM 3D Body checkpoint and MHR asset
implementation.repository_policy: Only code, protocol and a compact aggregate validation summary are committed. Model assets and generated samples remain on the server.

actual_mhr_contract.wrapper_axis_conversion: raw MHR vertices/keypoints/joints are multiplied by [1,-1,-1] before OpenCV-camera placement
actual_mhr_contract.topology_storage: One batch-level int32 topology_faces.npy with dtype/shape/content SHA-256; per-sample vertices reference that exact topology.
actual_mhr_contract.vertex_offsets: DISABLED: the current wrapper argument has no effect above repeated-forward numerical noise and is not exposed by the generator.

sampling.seed_derivation: NumPy SeedSequence([master_seed, identity_index, view_index]); identity shape/scale use a separate deterministic identity seed
sampling.global_trans: zero in MHR; metric camera placement is saved separately
sampling.body_rotation_parameters: indices 0:124 use N(0,0.11 rad), clipped to [-0.32,0.32]; embedded hand indices 62:116 are reset to zero
sampling.jaw_parameters: indices 130:133 fixed to zero because the current body wrapper slices to 130
sampling.expression: 72 zeros, matching the current SAM body head
sampling.camera: OpenCV pinhole, randomized 620-820 px focal length at 512x512, full azimuth, elevation within +/-25 degrees, roll within +/-5 degrees; distance derived from the actual generated mesh bounding sphere
sampling.raster_sample_coordinates: pyrender/OpenGL fragment centres at (column+0.5,row+0.5); independent depth rays use the identical sample coordinate
sampling.sampling_limit: These narrow bounds are an engineering smoke distribution chosen to avoid obvious MHR parameter explosions. They are not learned joint limits or a substitute for motion-capture pose sampling.

required_per_sample_artifacts.vertices_camera_m.npy: exact float32 18439x3 mesh vertices in saved OpenCV camera coordinates
required_per_sample_artifacts.camera.json: K, R, T, camera centre, image size, view angles, metric convention and depth definition
required_per_sample_artifacts.rgb.png: 512x512 rendered RGB composited on a deterministic procedural background
required_per_sample_artifacts.depth_z_m.npy: float32 metric first-surface camera Z-depth; zero background
required_per_sample_artifacts.mask.png: uint8 foreground mask exactly equal to depth_z_m > 0
required_per_sample_artifacts.keypoints_mhr308_camera_m.npy: all 308 MHR keypoints in camera coordinates
required_per_sample_artifacts.joints127_camera_m.npy: all 127 MHR skeleton joint coordinates in camera coordinates
required_per_sample_artifacts.keypoints_mhr308_projection.npz: 2D coordinates, in-frame flags, z-buffer visibility flags and sampled raster depth
required_per_sample_artifacts.sample.json: identity/view indices, all seeds, dimensions, topology/model/vertex hashes and artifact file hashes

visibility.definition: A keypoint is visible when it has positive Z, projects inside the image, has valid rendered depth, and its Z is no more than 0.08 m behind the first visible mesh surface.
visibility.reason_for_tolerance: MHR keypoints may be joint-centred or surface-regressed rather than lying exactly on the rasterized skin. Visibility is an engineering occlusion label, not a medical visibility label.
visibility.stored: all 308 labels are saved; visible count for the first MHR70 is summarized per sample

full_1000.authorization: Run only after smoke100 automatic and visual gates pass; generation does not authorize training.
full_1000.reason_for_identity_split: Shape and scale are shared within identity, so sample-level random splitting would leak synthetic identity geometry.
full_1000.validation: Run the same validator on every sample with at least 8 deterministic interior rays per sample, plus visual contact sheets stratified by identity and viewpoint.

params_to_mesh.procedure: Reload params.npz, run the same licensed MHR asset, apply the declared axis and saved camera transform, and compare vertices, 308 keypoints and 127 joints with saved arrays.
params_to_mesh.hashes: Verify model, topology, canonical stored vertex array and every artifact file hash.

mesh_to_depth_to_backprojection.procedure: Choose deterministic pixels after 7x7 silhouette erosion and exclusion of 3x3 depth ranges >=0.03 m, backproject saved Z-depth with K, intersect the corresponding OpenCV ray independently against every front-facing saved MHR triangle, and compare the first mesh intersection with the backprojected point.
mesh_to_depth_to_backprojection.rays: 16 per sample for smoke100; at least 8 per sample for full1000
mesh_to_depth_to_backprojection.additional_identity: Backprojected points must reproject to their source pixels within 1e-5 px. OpenGL back-face culling and (u+0.5,v+0.5) fragment-centre sampling are reproduced explicitly rather than absorbed into a wider threshold.

dataset_integrity: sample IDs and sample seeds are unique
shape and scale are byte-identical across all ten samples of one identity
each identity occurs in exactly one train/validation/test split
the shared topology file hash matches the manifest
image_contract: all foreground depth values are finite and positive
depth_mm.png is the exact clipped rounded-millimetre derivative

smoke_acceptance.visual: Inspect a 10x10 RGB/depth/mask contact sheet; no near-plane clipping, gross self-intersection, camera crop failure, empty body, face inversion or obvious broken topology
smoke_acceptance.failure_action: Write FAIL_DO_NOT_USE, preserve the failing sample and seed, fix the root cause, then generate into a new output directory. Never overwrite a failed run.

full_1000_acceptance.visual: Review at least 100 stratified samples including every identity and the azimuth/elevation extremes
full_1000_acceptance.distribution_review: Report pose/shape/scale/camera histograms and reject obvious pathological modes before any training proposal
full_1000_acceptance.training_boundary: Passing validates generator geometry only. A separate experiment must decide whether synthetic images improve real held-out HuMMan or target-domain RGB-D performance.
